name: module-size-budget
body: Every first-party production source file of the apg repository must stay within a small line budget — roughly 400 lines of production code per file. Test code is accounted separately: a module's unit/int tests live in a sibling `tests.rs` and do not count against the production budget, and top-level e2e test crates are not production source. `vendor/` and generated files are out of scope. A file over the budget is a violation unless a note records why it must be. The budget is a whole-repository law; this change-set applies it to the apg root Rust crate's first-party source (`src/*.rs`).
